definitions.recall_at_k: Per answerable question: required gold record IDs in top k distinct retrieved records divided by required gold IDs; aggregate is macro-average over answerable questions.
definitions.strict_multi_evidence_success_at_k: Share of answerable questions with at least two required gold IDs for which all required IDs are in top k distinct retrieved records.
definitions.any_gold_hit_at_k: Share of answerable questions with at least one required gold ID in top k distinct retrieved records.
definitions.unanswerable: Counted separately and excluded from retrieval recall, strict success, any-gold hit, and retrieval latency denominators.
definitions.deduplication: Repeated chunks from one record_id count once, preserving first-ranked occurrence.
